messages.text: Sorry to hear that. Which unit is it, and what's it doing, no power, no hashing, error on screen? Also, has it ever been overclocked or modified? That's the one thing that voids the warranty. And give me your order number so I can pull it up.

Got it. One quick check before I open it up: what's the postcode ···· to, or the name on the order?

And tell me which unit is faulty and what it's doing.

Powers on but zero hash usually means the pool settings didn't take. In the web UI, re-enter the stratum URL, port and worker, save, then reboot it, and watch whether shares start.

Still nothing after that and it's an RMA. I just need the postcode ····name on the order before I go further.

That's the one on this order, good. Was it ever overclocked or modified? Tampered units aren't covered.

If the pool re-entry didn't fix it, start the RMA here and you'll get a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform Processing takes up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse.

Last thing I need from you: the postcode ····order.

Thanks Michael, that's you. Three Gamma 602s, delivered September 25.

Is it one unit not hashing, or all three? That changes things, if it's all three I'd look at the pool or network first, since a whole batch failing the same way is usually config.

If it's just the one and the pool re-entry didn't help, fill in the RMA form and you'll get a return label.

That points at the unit, not your setup. One dead board out of three.

Fill in the RMA form and they'll send you a return label: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform Put the order number Shop···· on it and say it powers on but won't hash. Processing is up to 10 days once it lands at the warehouse.

One thing I still need: was that unit ever overclocked? Overclocked or modified units aren't covered.
